newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Accor not strategic for Suez/SGB - Suez.
newsitem.headline: Accor not strategic for Suez/SGB - Suez.

text.p: French hotel group Accor is not a strategic holding for French Compagnie de Suez and its Belgian unit Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB), Suez chief executive offier Gerald Mestrallet said on Thursday.

"I am not saying that we will sell our stake in Accor soon, but, honestly, I must admit that it is not a strategic participation for us," Mestrallet told Belgian financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd in an interview.
Suez holds 62.6 percent of SGB, which in turn owns nine percent of Accor.
SGB has a tradition of trying to have controlling stakes in all its subsidiaries. Earlier efforts to have a bigger say and stake in Accor have been blocked by Accor's independent-minded management.
